Vodafone/Salzgitter AMG-Mercedes: Run by HWA from Affalterbach. HWA builds and runs the Mercedes DTM cars. Bernd Schneider won the title in 2000, 2001 and 2003.
DaimlerChrysler Bank AMG-Mercedes: The second HWA car pair. Gary Paffett won the 2005 title with the team. Mika Häkkinen is in his second DTM season.
Audi Sport Team Abt: The second Abt Sportsline car pair from Kempten. Tom Kristensen is in his third DTM season.
Audi Sport Team Abt Sportsline: Hans-Jürgen Abt's team from Kempten. Runs the Audi works cars since 2004. Mattias Ekström won the 2004 title with the team.
Stern/Easy Rent AMG-Mercedes: Ingmar Persson's team. Runs one-year-old 2005 C-Klasse cars. Jean Alesi races his last DTM season here.
Audi Sport Team Rosberg: Keke Rosberg's team from Neustadt an der Weinstraße. Raced Mercedes until 2004. Returns with one-year-old 2005 Audi A4s.
TV-Spielfilm/TrekStor AMG-Mercedes: Peter Mücke's team from Berlin. Runs one-year-old 2005 C-Klasse cars.
Audi Sport Team Phoenix: Ernst Moser's team from Meuspath, next to the Nürburgring. Raced Opels until 2005. Runs one-year-old 2005 Audi A4s.
Futurecom TME: Colin Kolles' team from Greding. New in 2006. Runs two-year-old 2004 Audi A4s.
AutoScout24/Junge Gebrauchte AMG-Mercede: Two rookies on two-year-old 2004 C-Klasse cars. Car #21 is run by Persson, car #22 by Mücke.
